---
title: "Quarto Manuals"
format: html
---

This site documents and explains Quarto Manuals as a lightweight framework for 
executable software operation manuals.

This documentation will explain:

- the minimal starter template that Manual authors ship to End Users;
- the framework rules that make the template a Manual Page;
- full examples showing how the template scales from simple to advanced work.

The examples on this site are rendered copies of the kinds of project files the 
End-User should expect after running `quarto use template GITHUB_ORG/MANUAL_REPO`
to use a manual of that type.
